description: This file implements processor feature detection for various CPU architectures in Go, defining structures and variables for CPU features on architectures like x86, ARM, Loong64, MIPS, PowerPC, S390X, and RISC-V, along with functions for initializing and processing CPU feature options.

classes.name: CacheLinePad
classes.description: Struct used to pad CPU feature structs to avoid false sharing.

classes.name: option
classes.description: Struct representing CPU debug options that can be set via GODEBUG environment variable.

methods.name: processOptions
methods.description: Function to process GODEBUG environment variable settings for CPU features, enabling or disabling features accordingly.
